findings.title: Archived primary source, dated explicitly
findings.detail: The title and publication leaves establish first edition 2008, effective 1 January 2009. It is not represented as a complete current standard; later amendments and referenced methods remain open.

findings.title: Recipe scope is narrower
findings.detail: The monograph names Cinnamomum leaves/wood/roots and Ocimum whole plant, with hydrodistillation. Recipe 14.5 names Cinnamomum camphora only. Do not expand the recipe to Ocimum or synthetic material from the monograph alone.

findings.title: Optical rotation stays a source literal
findings.detail: The scan prints +41° +43° without an explicit separator. The helper preserves it and supplies no min/max values. It does not normalize punctuation into an acceptance interval.

findings.title: Purity is not a food-use dose
findings.detail: The medicinal dose and therapeutic-use sections are not imported into the helper. Q.S., assay purity and botanical-name alignment do not establish a safe food inclusion rate.

findings.title: Pesticide cross-reference is not an FSSAI MRL
findings.detail: API Appendix 2.5 remains a source pointer. No drug-monograph residue value is mapped to a raw food commodity or a finished dish.

findings.title: Method-only Karpura remains held
